recipes.name: Sautéed zucchini and shrimp (Aehobak-saeu-bokkeum)
ingredients: 1 pound zucchini, cut into ¼ inch thick bite size pieces
8 ounces large heads-off shrimp (or frozen and thawed), shelled, deveined, washed
1 tablespoon salted fermented shrimp (or fish sauce), minced
1 red chili pepper, stemmed and sliced diagonally
instructions: Combine the zucchini and salt in a bowl. Mix it well and let it sit for 10 minutes. Drain.
Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add the vegetable oil, garlic, and stir for 20 seconds.
Stir in the zucchini and onion for about 10 seconds. Push the zucchini and onion to the edges and empty out the center of the skillet.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the shrimp side by side to the empty spot in the middle of the skillet. Let them cook for 1 minute, until the bottom of the shrimp turns a little pink.
Turn them over and stir everything together for a minute.
Add shrimp sauce (or fish sauce) and cook 7 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until the shrimp is cooked and the zucchini is semi-translucent.
Add red chili pepper and green onion and stir another minute.
Remove from the heat and stir in sesame oil.
Transfer to a bowl or plate and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over top. Serve right away with rice. You can refrigerate the leftovers for up to 3 days.
